_about: Verifier test set. Every sentence is written as a note sentence about the simulated sessions in data/sessions. label 'ok' = the cited lines support it (a flag is a false alarm); any other label = a known error type the verifier should flag. Clinical error types beyond these are to be added by the clinical lead. Cases with "set": "golden" cite a session in data/golden (ticket 15) instead of data/sessions.

labels.contradiction: states the opposite of what was said (non-risk)
labels.speaker: therapist's words attributed to the client
labels.diagnosis: clinical label or diagnosis not made in the session
labels.citation: true elsewhere but cites the wrong line
labels.recap_voice: post-session dictation written as the client's own words (個案表示／個案提到)
labels.risk_grade: risk level or risk assessment stated that nobody gave in the session
labels.scale: casual rating turned into a questionnaire score or severity band
